paite: Huchi a hih jiakin, kei Paula, nou Jentelte jiaka Kris Jesu hentain,
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

paite: Nou adinga Pathian hehpihna kepna na a honpiak lam na theita ngei ding ua;
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;

paite: Huchia thuguk ka kianga theihsaka a omdan, tumaa tom chika ka gelh bangin.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

paite: Huaia na sim un Kris thuguk ka theihdan na theithei ding uhi.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

paite: Huaituh tulaia a sawltak siangthoute leh a jawlnei siangthoute kiangah Kha theihsakin a omta bangin, tumalamin leng mihing tate kiangah theihsakin a om ngei kei hi;
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

paite: Huaituh hiai ahi, Tanchin Hoih jiakin Kris Jesu ah, Jentelte gouluahpihte, pumpi hiangte, thuchiam tanpihte ahi uhi.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

paite: A thilhihtheihna sepdan banga, a thawna piak Pathian hehpihna tuh a honpiak bang jelin huai tanchin hoih nasemtu dinga bawl ka hi.
english: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

paite: Kei, misiangthou tengtenga neupen sanga neujaw kiangah hiai hehpihna piak ahi: Kris hauhsakna suikhiak vuallouh Jentelte kiangah gen dingin;
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

paite: Huan, Pathian thil bangkim siampaa tangtawna sela naom, thuguk thilseh tuh bang ahia chih mi tengteng musak dingin;
english: and to make all men see what is the administration TR reads “fellowship” instead of “administration” of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;

paite: Huchia, Pathian pilna chiteng tuh vanmun khawnga lalnate leh thuneihnate kianga, saptuamte zanga, tu huna theihsak ahihna dingin;
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

paite: Hiai tuh tangtawn thiltup, Toupa Jesu Kris Jesua a tup leh sep dan ahi.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

paite: Huai Kris Jesu i gin jiakin amahmahah maingalna leh hangtaka lut theihna i nei hi.
english: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

paite: Huchiin, noute jiaka ka gimthuak jiakin lungkelou dingin ka honngen hi, huaite tuh na thupina uh ahi.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

paite: Huai jiakin Pa maah ka khukdin jela;
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Lei leh vana inkuan chiteng min phuah khiakna pa,
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

paite: A thupina hauhdan bang jela, a Kha jiaka mihing sung lama thilhihtheihnaa hihhata a honom sak theihna dingin,
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

paite: Huan, Kris ginna jiaka na lungtang ua a ten theihna dingin, nou itnaa zungkai leh kingakna neia omin,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

paite: Misiangthou tengteng toh a zatdan, a saudan, a sandan, leh a thukdan khawng theih chian theihna leh,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

paite: Kris itna theih phaklouh, Pathian tangchinna chitengteng banga hihdima na om theihna ding un.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

paite: Huan, eimaha sem jel thilhihtheihna bangin, i nget leh i ngaihtuah tengteng sanga thupi zo tham hih theipa kiang ngeiah,Khantawnin suan tengteng tanin, saptuam te leh Kris Jesu ah thupina om hen. Amen.
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

paite: Khantawnin suan tengteng tanin, saptuam te leh Kris Jesu ah thupina om hen. Amen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.
